## 更新日志
- 迁移至 **Modern Xposed Module API（Libxposed API 101）**
- 由于弃用 **XSharedPreferences**，本次更新后所有配置项将会丢失，请务必在更新前备份配置，并在更新后重新进行设置  
- 适配 **HyperOS 3.0（包括 3.0.300+）**。本版本仅供 HyperOS 3 用户使用，对 HyperOS 2 及更早版本的支持已被移除  
- 新增功能：**系统界面 → 图标定制 → 双排信号图标**  
- 新增功能：**系统界面 → 图标调整 → 组合图标**  
- 新增功能：**系统界面 → 图标调整 → 状态栏图标左移**  
- 新增功能：**系统界面 → 手势与操作 → 单击 / 双击空白区域触发特定动作**  
- 大量细节与功能已作调整与优化，暂不一一列出，欢迎自行探索  
- 欢迎加入 [Telegram 频道](https://t.me/lackluster_stuff) 反馈问题、获取内部测试版本与后续更新信息  

---

## What's Changed
- Migrated to the **Modern Xposed Module API (Libxposed API 101)**
- **XSharedPreferences** has been deprecated. As a result, all existing configurations will be lost after updating. Please back up your settings in advance and reconfigure them after the update  
- Added support for **HyperOS 3.0 (including 3.0.300+)**. This version is intended **only for HyperOS 3**; support for HyperOS 2 and earlier has been removed  
- New feature: **System UI → Icon customizer → Dual-row signal icons**  
- New feature: **System UI → Icon tuner → Combined icons**  
- New feature: **System UI → Icon tuner → Shift status bar icons to the left**  
- New feature: **System UI → Single / double tap on empty area to trigger specific actions**  
- Numerous behavior tweaks and refinements have been made and are not fully listed here—feel free to explore  
- Join our [Telegram channel](https://t.me/lackluster_stuff) to report issues, get insider builds, and stay up to date with future releases

## 更新日志
- 最后一个支持 HyperOS 2.0 的版本
- 此版本暂未适配 HyperOS 3.0，请等待下一个更新
- 加入 [Telegram 频道](https://t.me/lackluster_stuff) 以反馈问题并获取内部更新
- 新增功能 **系统界面-锁屏-解锁后保留通知**
- 新增功能 **系统界面-锁屏-自动打开手电筒**
- 新增功能 **系统界面-通知中心-展开通知**
- 新增功能 **系统界面-控制中心-始终显示电池百分比**
- 增强净化

----------

## What's Changed
- Final version to support HyperOS 2.0.
- This version is not yet compatible with HyperOS 3.0. Please wait for the next update.
- Join our [Telegram channel](https://t.me/lackluster_stuff) to report issues and receive insider updates.
- New feature: **System UI -> Lock screen -> Keep notifications after unlocking**.
- New feature: **System UI -> Lock screen -> Turn on the flashlight automatically**.
- New feature: **System UI -> Notification shade -> Expand notifications**.
- New feature: **System UI -> Control center -> Always show battery percentage**.

## 更新日志
- _主要功能已适配 HyperOS 2.0.200+，建议**重置**模块设置_
- **系统界面->图标调整** 支持忽略系统设置（2.0.200+）
- 新增功能 **系统界面->Miuix 样式的展开按钮**，和**的莫奈取色按钮说再见吧！
- 新增功能 **系统界面->媒体控件风格**，孩子们，我回来了！
- 新增功能 **系统界面->自定义主题色**，再见了，所有的莫奈取色
- 新增功能 **系统框架->字体缩放**，将最小字体缩放改回0.86，我买的不是老年机
- 新增功能 **桌面->手势触发特定功能支持小窗前台程序**
- 增强净化

----------

## What's Changed
- _Added support for HyperOS 2.0.200+ (It is recommended to **reset** module settings)_
- **System UI -> Icon tuner** now support ignoring system settings (2.0.200+)
- New feature: **System UI -> Miuix style expand button**
- New feature: **System UI -> Media control styles**
- New feature: **System UI -> Custom theme color**
- New feature: **Android Framework -> Font scale**
- New feature: **System launcher -> Gesture-triggered functions now support minimizing the current foreground app into a floating window**

## 更新日志

- 关注 [Telegram 频道](https://t.me/lackluster_stuff) 以获取预览与测试更新 
- **严禁在酷安等任何国内平台宣传净化页的功能，严禁二次传播**

### 更新内容

- 支持 HyperOS 2 (不再支持 HyperOS 1)
- 新增 DexKit 缓存
- 新 UI
- 新增 **状态栏->字体**
- 新增 **状态栏->禁用智能深色**
- 新增 **桌面->增强返回手势触觉反馈**
- **桌面->增强返回手势** 支持触发更多功能
- **桌面->强制应用程序标签/状态栏/负一屏颜色**（深色模式下需开启禁用智能深色）
- 新增 搜索使用自定义的搜索引擎
- 净化功能换新

### 已知问题

- **桌面->大文件夹内图标大小自适应**会导致文件夹动画异常
- 部分 UI 细节问题

### 注意
- 由于 OS2 已官方支持桌面模糊，当前（和后续）版本不再提供**桌面->高级模糊效果**功能
- 暂不支持**系统界面->自定义媒体控件**
- 当前（和后续）版本不再支持 HyperOS 1
- 当前（和后续）版本不再维护对平板的针对性适配

------

## Changelog  

### Updates  
- Added support for **HyperOS 2**  
- Added **DexKit cache**  
- **New UI** design  
- Added **System UI -> Font** 
- Added **System UI -> Disable Smart dark**  
- Added **System launcher -> Enhanced back gesture haptic feedback**  
- **System launcher -> Enhanced back gesture** now supports more functions  
- **System launcher -> Force App label/Status bar/Minus screen color** (requires enabling **Disable Smart dark**)  
- Added **Custom Search Engine** support for Search app  
- **Clean master** redesigned  

### Known Issues  
- **System launcher -> Adaptive icon size in large folders** may cause abnormal folder animations  

### Notes  
- **System launcher -> Advanced Blur Effect** has been removed in current (and future) versions, as **OS2** now natively supports launcher blur  
- **System UI -> Custom Media Controls** is temporarily unavailable  
- **HyperOS 1** is no longer supported in current (and future) versions  
- **Tablet-specific optimizations** will no longer be maintained in current (and future) versions

### 更新日志

#### 高级模糊效果

- 支持平板（部分功能）
- 新增负一屏模糊
- 新增贝塞尔曲线动画
- 新增同步壁纸缩放（与其它壁纸缩放模块等不兼容）
- 修改兼容性模式（有问题可尝试打开）

#### 其它

- 修复自定义媒体控件样式的异常颜色

---

### Changelog

#### Advanced blur effects

- Support tablets.
- Support for minus screen blur.
- Support for Bezier curve animation.
- Support for new wallpaper scaling method.
- Improve compatibility.

#### Others

- Fix abnormal colors for Custom Media Control.

## 更新日志

### 新增
- 改善的用户界面
- 模块精简模式（只启用“自定义媒体控件”和“桌面高级模糊效果”两个功能）
- 强制控制电池指示器的显示模式（忽略系统设置）
- 高级模糊效果新增文件夹背景模糊
- 高级模糊效果适配平板桌面
- 高级模糊效果的动画曲线调整增加曲线预览
- 锁屏界面的运营商标签位置（左上角）可显示运营商标签或时间

### 修复
- 自定义媒体控件的尺寸问题
- 高级模糊效果的资源错误释放（部分动画曲线下模糊完全失效）
- 最近任务无法显示真实内存占用
- 备份与恢复数据类型问题
- 部分文本错误

### 其它
- 已测试手机桌面版本：RELEASE-4.39.15.8280-07041845 (439158280)
- 已测试平板桌面版本：RELEASE-4.40.0.7202-05162110 (440007202)
- 目前（手机）桌面版本较多，暂不会适配新版本（如重构版桌面）
- 由于之前的备份功能有些问题，强烈建议**不要使用/恢复之前的备份文件**

------

## Changelog

### Feature
- Improved UI
- Lite mode (Only load core functionality)
- Modify the style of the battery indicator (ignore system settings)
- Blur the background when opening a folder **[Advanced blur effects]**
- Support for tablets **[Advanced blur effects]**
- Improved custom animation curves **[Advanced blur effects]**
- Carrier label position on the lock screen can display the carrier label or time

### Bugfix
- Incorrect size of the media control panel **[Customize the style of the media control]**
- Blur effect disappears unexpectedly (when using some animated curves) **[Advanced blur effects]**
- Unable to show real memory usage in recent tasks **[Show real memory usage]**
- Crash after restoring a backup file
- Some textual errors

### Other
- Recommended version of system launcher (Phone): RELEASE-4.39.15.8280-07041845 (439158280)
- Recommended version of system launcher (Pad): RELEASE-4.40.0.7202-05162110 (440007202)
- It is strongly recommended to **AVOID using/restoring previous backup files**

### 更新日志

- 新增功能：自定义媒体控件样式

### Changelog

- Support for customizing the style of the media control.

### 更新日志

- 修复上个版本压暗开关无效的问题
- 微调模糊动画

### Changelog

- Fix the issue that the dim switch doesn't work.

### 更新日志

#### 重点更新
- 修改了桌面高级模糊效果使用的模糊方案（修改为通知面板使用的模糊方案）

#### 新增功能（桌面高级模糊效果）
- 提高性能（小米没有开放相关文档，我也不知道具体原因）
- 允许更大的模糊半径
- 分离模糊和压暗，两者现在可以独立控制与生效
- 更多的模糊动画缺失修复（不建议开启）

#### 修复问题
- 修复桌面高级模糊效果与强制启用高级材质的冲突
- 修复新版本自定义通知图标个数失效的问题

-----

### Changelog

#### Highlights
- Modified the blur solution used for the launcher advanced blur effect.

#### Others
- Fix the conflict between advanced blur effect and force high-quality materials.
- Fix the issue that customizing the number of notification icons does not work in the new version.

### 更新日志

#### 重点更新
- 桌面高级模糊效果（暂不支持平板）

#### 新增功能
- 同步壁纸缩放与应用启动动画
- 修改桌面模糊半径

#### 修复问题
- 无法判断设备Root状态
- 修复平板模糊增强意外消失（第n次追加修复）

-----

### Changelog

#### Highlights
- Advanced blur effects for launcher (Do not support tablets)

#### Others
- Supports synchronizing wallpaper zoom with app launch.
- Supports modifying the blur radius of the launcher.
- Fix the problem that cannot determine the Root status of the device.
- Fix the "Blur Enhancement" added blurring will disappear in some cases (on tablets) again.

### 更新日志

#### 新增
- 移除桌面卸载应用时的举报按钮
- 屏蔽安装应用时诱导开启安全守护的弹窗（可能有问题）
- 状态栏时间显示秒、显示上午/下午、显示先导0
- 通知设置重定向可使用弹窗选择应用通知设置和对应通知类别设置
- 解锁网络通话助手

#### 修改
- 修改桌面伪装高端设备逻辑
- 修改传送门/小爱自定义搜索引擎的逻辑
- 修复模糊增强导致的在文件夹内开启关闭应用后模糊消失
- 修改隐藏运营商标签的方式

-----

### Changelog

- Support removing the report button when uninstalling apps from the launcher.
- Support blocking the popup window that induces to turn on Safe Mode when installing apps (may be problematic)
- Support showing seconds, AM/PM, and leading 0 in status bar time.
- Support unlocking VoIP assistant
- Improved notification settings redirection. App notification settings and channel notification settings can now be selected using a popup window.
- Fix blurring enhancement causing blurring to disappear after opening and closing apps in a folder
- Modify the implementation of disguise as high end device for launcher
- Modify the implementation of custom search engine for Taplus/Mi AI.
- Modify the implementation of hiding operator label
